Which automorphism keys exist

Source: R/object-accessors.R
get_existing_eval_automorphism_key_indices.Rd

get_existing_eval_automorphism_key_indices() returns the automorphism indices for which keys are registered under a key tag. get_eval_automorphism_no_key_indices() returns those of a given set of indices that have no key yet. get_unique_values() is the set difference they are built on: the values of new_values that are not in old_values.

Usage

get_existing_eval_automorphism_key_indices(key_tag)

get_eval_automorphism_no_key_indices(key_tag, indices)

get_unique_values(old_values, new_values)

Arguments

key_tag

Character string; the tag of the secret key the keys were generated for (see get_key_tag()).

indices, old_values, new_values

Integer vectors.

Value

An integer vector in increasing order.

Details

The indices are automorphism indices, as find_automorphism_index() returns, not rotation amounts.
